description: This file defines the RV_Sync class which manages synchronization and update checking for Revive Adserver, including version parsing and XML-RPC communication with a remote server.

classes.name: RV_Sync
classes.description: A class to handle synchronization, version parsing, and update checking for Revive Adserver.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes configuration and database handle for the sync process.

methods.name: getConfigVersion
methods.description: Converts a version string into a numeric value for comparison, handling beta, rc, stable tags.

methods.name: checkForUpdates
methods.description: Connects to the remote server via XML-RPC to check for available updates, handling errors and caching results.
